name: Phantasy Star II Text Adventure: Kainz no Bouken
original_name: ファンタシースターII テキストアドベンチャー カインズの冒険
source:
Phantasy Star II Text Adventures were a series of eight text adventure videogames available to users of Sega Meganet, a modem for the Sega Mega Drive in Japan, and later released as part of two compilations on the Sega Mega-CD. Each of the games takes place shortly before Phantasy Star II, documenting the backgrounds of its characters, and explaining what brings them to the town Paseo where they eventually team up to investigate the pervasive troubles of the Algol Solar System.

Kinds's Adventure

Josh Kain (or Kain Ji An, Japanese: カインズ・ジ・アン Kainzu) is an 18 year old aspiring engineer who always loved machines, and had become quite knowledgeable in how electrical devices and robots function. He built many small devices, fixed appliances, and even learned to hack computers. However, due to being scatterbrained and clumsy, he would sometimes destroy the things he tried to fix. Eventually, after one particularly disastrous repair job, he gave up trying to be an engineer, deciding instead to put his "talent" for destroying things to good use. Thus did he become a "wrecker", his job being to trash anything electronic. He starts off joining a gang of rebels out to destroy Mother Brain, and eventually ends up teaming up with Rolf in Phantasy Star II towards that very end.

[From: [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phantasy_Star_II_Text_Adventures]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
《梦幻之星II文字冒险》是由八部文字冒险游戏组成的系列，最初面向日本世嘉Mega Drive调制解调器Sega Meganet用户推出，后来作为两部合集的一部分登陆世嘉Mega-CD。每部游戏都发生在《梦幻之星II》正篇稍早之前，讲述各角色的背景，以及他们如何来到帕塞欧镇，最终结成队伍，共同调查阿尔戈尔太阳系不断蔓延的危机。

凯因兹的冒险

乔希·凯因（日文名：カインズ・ジ・アン）是一名18岁的准工程师，从小热爱机械，对电气设备与机器人运行原理十分了解。他制造过许多小装置，修理过各种电器，甚至学会了入侵电脑。然而，由于粗心大意、动作笨拙，他有时反而会毁掉原本想修好的东西。一次格外灾难性的维修后，他终于放弃成为工程师，决定把自己破坏事物的“才能”用于正途。就这样，他成了一名专门摧毁电子设备的“破坏者”。起初，他加入一群企图摧毁母脑的反抗者，最后则在《梦幻之星II》中与罗尔夫结成队伍，为同一目标而战。
